title: Monitoring
subtitle: Is it holding up against real visitors?

panels.body_md: The monitor compares what the live model predicts now against what it predicted on the training-era reference. Every tracked signal has drifted — **real visitors draw differently than the dataset**, and mean confidence has fallen from {refMean} to {curMean}. That is expected rather than a failure: it is what the monitor is for, and it is the signal the retrain flywheel uses.
